north_star: Use brand/platform knowledge to shrink the search space, then identify ECUs before querying proprietary DIDs.

steps.name: identify_brand_and_model
actions: Read VIN by standard OBD/UDS paths where available.
Resolve model/chassis code and approximate production generation before choosing transport branch.
steps.success: brand=SEAT and platform branch is known or explicitly unknown

steps.name: passive_transport_detection
actions: Record standard vs extended CAN IDs and bus activity.
If legacy/6J branch is possible, preserve K-line/TP1.6/TP2.0 as alternate transports rather than assuming UDS.

policy.can11_expected_bitrate: 500 kbit/s on documented modern VAG diagnostic CAN

decision_hints.hint: model=Leon KL or gateway part prefix 5WA / GW2020 High

steps.name: known_route_presence_and_identity
modern_can_probe_order: 0x712->0x77C steering assist (general VAG MQB candidate; NOT Mii electric)
optional modules based on platform inventory and VAG route catalogue

identity_request_strategy.note: openDBC uses a Volkswagen multi-DID firmware identification request. If an ECU rejects multi-DID form, retry single DIDs within budget.

steps.name: fingerprint_and_family_match
actions: Store route, supplier, part number, HW/SW, system name and observed ASAM/ODX identity when available.
Match against ECU-family hypotheses before importing sensor decoders.

steps.name: known_did_queries
actions: Query route-specific source-confirmed model DIDs first.
Then query make-level candidates, preserving ambiguous decoder variants.
Do not enter extended diagnostic session automatically in product mode.

steps.name: bounded_fallback
conditions: SEAT is known but platform remains unresolved
CAN11/UDS transport has been positively detected
known VAG route allowlist did not inventory enough ECUs
actions: Try remaining VAG UDS route catalogue entries first.
Only then permit conservative 11-bit enumeration 0x700-0x7F6 excluding 0x7DF.
29-bit enumeration remains disabled unless exact new evidence authorizes a normalized pattern.
